title: The share of their own contacts a provincial employment service's jobseekers will start in its digital assistant in March and April 2027, after eight weeks in which the upgraded assistant answers every call
subdomain: decision-making and computational behavioural modelling (a reinforcement-learning model of jobseekers' contact-by-contact channel choices, with the learning from contacts they did not choose estimated from overflow transfers and carried through eight weeks of such contacts)
prompt_shape: one forecast share to the whole per cent for an eight-week window; employers' conversations and the service's own staff and test conversations in each month of 2026

distractors.why_relevant: the workforce team's record of when the claimant queue was in overflow, the episodes the transfers came from
distractors.why_unused: the legs export marks every transfer on the call itself and the voice session gives its outcome; the log adds nothing a figure reads
distractors.ruled_out_by: the legs export's leg_result and transfer_to

distractors.why_relevant: jobseekers' satisfaction with each channel, which looks like a driver of channel choice
distractors.why_unused: a 6 per cent sample with about three in ten answering; the choices and outcomes themselves are in the exports; no figure reads it
distractors.ruled_out_by: its own coverage (a sample of contacts)
